root.name: Slav Defense: Soultanbeieff Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. Nc3 dxc4 5. a4 e6

overview: In the Slav Alapin Black builds a Semi-Slav-like set-up with ...e6 while keeping the c4 pawn. White tries to regain it with e3 and Bxc4 or gain central space with e4. Play is a strategic fight over the c4 pawn and the e4 push; I am not sure of the exact main line.

white_ideas.idea: Regain c4 with e3 and Bxc4 or play e4

typical_structures.structure: Slav/Semi-Slav hybrid with pressure on c4 and d4

character.notes: Neither especially solid nor sharp as far as I know.

gambit.notes: The c4 pawn is not a gambit.

level.notes: Understanding of the c4 pawn matters.
